description: Überschwemmungsgebiete- Landkreis Leipzig is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Areas of flooding established under Paragraph 72(1) and 72(2) of the Sächsisches Wassergesetz and Paragraph 72(3) of the SächsWG. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Flooding areas — district of Leipzig" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Überschwemmungsgebiete, Hochwasserschutz. The listing shows 2019-11-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
